goals.0: Overflow the strcpy in the setuid /manpage/manpage0 binary and recover manpage1's privileges via the saved set-user-ID to read its password file.
goals.1: Overflow strcpy in /manpage/manpage1 despite its strlen check that raises SIGTERM after the copy.
goals.2: Defeat the getpass checker in /manpage/manpage2, abusing its argv[0] re-exec and an inherited open password-file descriptor.
goals.3: Match a 256-byte random password compared with strcmp in /manpage/manpage3, exploiting strcmp's stop-at-NUL semantics.
goals.4: Win the seeded Wumpus game in /manpage/manpage4 and abuse log_winner's unbounded sprintf over its uninitialized firstname/lastname buffers to return into shellcode copied into its own frame.
